import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import konumsal as ko
In [2]:
I = plt.imread("../data/domates.png")[:, :, :3]
J = ko.oteleme(I, tx=100, ty=100)

plt.figure()
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.imshow(I)

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.imshow(J)
plt.show()
